FIND YOUR SPACE IN EL NIDO, PALAWAN 🌴

Looking to own land, build a home, or invest in El Nido?

Palawan Property Group offers property opportunities across selected areas of El Nido, Palawan, from naturally green inland locations to coastal and island settings.

El Nido continues to evolve as a major tourism destination, while developments such as Lio Estate are creating an integrated environment for tourism, hospitality, commercial activity, residential communities, and leisure. Lio is Ayala Land’s master-planned tourism estate in El Nido, designed around the area’s natural landscape and sustainable development principles.

With Lio featuring hotels, restaurants, shops, leisure facilities, transportation infrastructure, and expanding mixed-use opportunities, the surrounding areas of El Nido present compelling possibilities for buyers looking at the long-term potential of Palawan real estate.
